name: Xilousuchus
sum: Xilousuchus is a sail-backed poposauroid pseudosuchian from the Early Triassic Heshanggou Formation of Shanxi, China, among the oldest known archosaurs.
wsnote: Possibly 3-4 m long, with a skull about 25 cm and a neck about 45 cm (English Wikipedia, rev. 1364960478); an estimate, not a measurement.
holotype: IVPP V 6026, a well-preserved partial skeleton including the skull, from the Heshanggou Formation, Hazhen commune, Ordos Basin, Fugu County, Shanxi.
material: The holotype; the sources consulted describe no other specimens.
biology: Described as a probable active hunter with long, powerful legs, a small head, a long neck and a sail along the neck and back; this reconstruction of habits is from the Wikipedia summary, not a direct study of behaviour.
author: Wu 1981

sources.text: X. Wu. 1981. The discovery of a new thecodont from north-east Shensi. Vertebrata PalAsiatica 19:122-132
